title: Every answer is a number
text: Guess the answer to a trivia question on your phone.

scene.tv: How many keys on a piano?

title: Guesses get odds
text: Guesses line up smallest to largest. The middle pays 2 to 1, outliers pay more.

title: Bet on the closest
text: Bet chips on the guess closest without going over. You get two free chips each round and can stake points too.

title: Cash in
text: Right bets pay their odds. The guesser closest without going over earns a bonus. The final round pays double!
